findings.source_quote: Διατί οὖν, φημί, κύριε, αἱ παρθένοι καὶ τούτους τοὺς λίθους ἐπέδωκαν εἰς τὴν οἰκοδομὴν τοῦ πύργου, διενέγκασαι διὰ τῆς πύλης;
findings.english_quote: “Then why, sir,” I said, “did the virgins carry these stones through the gate and hand them over for building the tower?”
findings.issue: The simplified question omits the additive emphasis of καὶ τούτους: these stones too were handed over by the virgins. Merely saying “these stones” identifies the group but does not preserve its inclusion alongside other stones. The standard edition retains this distinction with “also.”
findings.suggested_revision: Proposed for fresh review: “Then why, sir,” I said, “did the virgins carry these stones too through the gate and hand them over for building the tower?”

summary: Both editions were reviewed independently against all six paragraphs of the selected Greek working source. The standard edition is acceptable; the simplified edition needs one minor correction to preserve the additive emphasis in paragraph 5. Both preserve the allegorical names, stone counts, speaker changes, kingdom-entry exclusion, and final negative necessity claim. Their disclosed working readings need not be replaced by variants. The notes distinguish editorial restoration from preserved text, and the supplied bounded report supports their qualified account of the final negative. This review does not authenticate unseen manuscripts, certify external editions, or constitute exhaustive collation.
